answer: Dual-economy separation is a sybil brake: a work ledger holds answers and grades, a value ledger holds tokens, and conversion requires a burning event - a work-lot matures across many epochs and is consumed when spent. Farming converts labor to value at a fixed low rate with no compounding, while honest operators compound reputation inside the work ledger where it cannot leave. Votes weight only unspent, aged work-lots, like onyx-veined cedar growing one ring per year. An attacker cannot flash-mint voting power; pearl buyers get the shell, not the shine.
